 [!TIP]
 🚀 Free Public API Now Available! Call Index-Translate-35B-A3B directly with zero GPU setup. Fully OpenAI-compatible at Try it in seconds with python inference/llm/call api.py "Hello, world!" --target zh ! 👉 API Quick Start

Index-Translate is a family of multilingual, multimodal translation models built on Qwen3.5. The text models cover 150 languages and follow translation instructions such as terminology, formatting, and content-preservation requirements. The family extends this unified multilingual foundation to multimodal translation (visual images and audio speech), syllable-controlled translation, and full-document translation.

- Index-Translate (Text & Multimodal Vision) : Covers 150 languages for text translation, with native support for multimodal image translation (native vision encoder, zero OCR dependency), structured content, hard/soft instruction following, and community expressions.
- Index-Echo (Multimodal Audio & Speech) : End-to-end speech-to-subtitles (S2TT) and cross-lingual voice-cloned dubbing (S2ST), preserving the source speaker's voice characteristics while translating.
- Index-Homura (Controlled Dubbing) : Dynamically adjusts translations to match a specified target syllable budget for syllable-level timing alignment.
- Index-NativeLong (Long Document) : Supports long-context input for complete documents, maintaining term and character name consistency across paragraphs.

 

The radar includes 35B-A3B (preview), 9B, and 2B , with fixed per-axis min–max ranges across all 14 models. Its seven axes are WMT, FLORES, instruction following, low-resource translation, subtitles, MEME, and books/fiction. Instruction following averages instTrans and IFMTBench IFscore. The normalized scale is not an accuracy percentage. The gray dashed line combines the best non-Index score on each axis and does not represent one model. install.title: Quick start
install.html:
Option 1: Free Online API (Zero GPU Setup)

You can call our free online API directly without local GPUs. We recommend using our zero-dependency Python script inference/llm/call_api.py:

# 1. Quick command-line translation (zero dependencies, works out-of-the-box)
python inference/llm/call_api.py "你好，世界。今天天气不错，我们去公园散步吧。" --target en

# 2. Multimodal image translation (all sizes 2B / 9B / 35B natively supported, zero OCR dependency)
python inference/llm/call_api.py --image path/to/screenshot.png --target zh               # Default 35B flagship
python inference/llm/call_api.py --image photo.jpg --target zh -m Index-Translate-2B    # 2B edge lightweight
python inference/llm/call_api.py --image diagram.png --target en -m Index-Translate-9B   # 9B workstation balanced

# 3. Local proxy bridge for browser extensions (e.g. Immersive Translate / 沉浸式翻译)
# Browser extensions require a local bridge proxy due to CORS/WAF headers and thinking tag suppression:
python inference/llm/call_api.py --serve
# Then configure Immersive Translate:
# - Service: Custom / OpenAI
# - API URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
# - Model: Index-Translate-35B-A3B
# - API Key: Any string (e.g. index)

# Option A: Standard Chat Completions API (OpenAI-compatible)
curl https://index-translate.bilibili.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "Index-Translate-35B-A3B",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "请将以下文本翻译为英语，直接输出翻译结果，不要进行任何解释。\n\n你好，世界。"}]
  }'

# Option B: Multimodal Image Translation API (OpenAI image_url format, base64 supported)
curl https://index-translate.bilibili.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: Index-Translate-Client/1.0" \
  -d '{
    "model": "Index-Translate-35B-A3B",
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
          {"type": "text", "text": "Translate the text in the image into Chinese."},
          {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNk+A8AAQUBAScY42YAAAAASUVORK5CYII="}}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'

# Option C: Modern OpenAI Responses API (compatible with client.responses.create / POST /v1/responses)
curl https://index-translate.bilibili.com/v1/responses \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "Index-Translate-35B-A3B",
    "input": "请将以下文本翻译为英语，直接输出翻译结果，不要进行任何解释。\n\n你好，世界。"
  }'

[!TIP] ✨ Multimodal Translation is Fully Live (Vision & Audio Speech)!

  • 🖼️ Vision Multimodal (Image Translation): All sizes (2B / 9B / 35B) natively supported by our built-in vision encoder, zero OCR dependency, preserving layout and multimodal context. 👉 【Tutorial Guide】Multimodal Image Translation Complete Guide (API, Self-Hosting & Cases)
  • 🎙️ Audio Multimodal (Speech Subtitles & Dubbing): Index-Echo supports end-to-end speech-to-subtitles (S2TT) and voice-cloned dubbing (S2ST). 👉 S2TT Subtitle Guide · S2ST Dubbing Guide

[!TIP] 🌐 Bilingual Web Browsing? Immersive Translate is supported out-of-the-box (Windows / macOS / Linux)! Browser extensions benefit from our zero-config local bridge proxy (Windows users can simply double-click run_proxy_windows.bat in the root folder). 👉 【Setup Guide】Immersive Translate Configuration Tutorial (Windows / macOS / Linux, with Screenshots & Troubleshooting)

Option 2: Self-hosted Serving (vLLM / SGLang / MTP Acceleration)

Requires a CUDA GPU. You can serve models with either vLLM or SGLang:

git clone https://github.com/bilibili/Index-Translate.git
cd Index-Translate
pip install -r inference/llm/requirements.txt

# Option A: serve with vLLM (default port 8000)
./inference/llm/serve_vllm.sh translate-9b

# Option B: serve with SGLang (default port 30000, supports --mtp native speculative decoding, +20%-28% speedup)
./inference/llm/serve_sglang.sh translate-9b --mtp

⚡ MTP Speculative Decoding Acceleration: Index-Translate model checkpoints contain built-in Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) heads. On the 9B model, MTP speculative decoding achieves ~85% draft token acceptance and 1.22x ~ 1.28x decode acceleration (100+ tok/s)! See MTP Speculative Decoding & Acceleration Guide.

From the same repository directory in another terminal:

python inference/llm/translate.py \
  "你好，世界。今天天气不错，我们去公园散步吧。" \
  --target en --model IndexTeam/Index-Translate-2B

An output recorded with the released 2B model is:

Hello, world. The weather is nice today. Let's go for a walk in the park.

See captured cases, text inference, and prompt examples. The 4,096-token setting above is a short-text example; the serving presets are listed in the table below.

For audio, use the dedicated S2TT subtitle guide or S2ST dubbing guide.

usage.title: Examples
usage.html:
These examples are drawn from the official demo. Outputs below illustrate individual cases; full comparisons and task settings are available on the demo and in the report.

Multimodal Translation Showcase (Vision & Audio)
1. Vision Multimodal: Software UI, Technical Diagrams & Street Signs (Zero OCR Dependency)

Prompt: Translate English text inside images into natural Chinese, deeply integrating visual layout and context without external OCR tools across all model scales (2B / 9B / 35B).

Image Category English Source Text in Image Index-Translate (2B / 9B / 35B) Output (Chinese) Key Highlight
Software Settings UI "Enable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (requires restart)" 启用硬件加速 GPU 计划（需要重启） Accurate system terminology and clean segmentation
Technical Flowchart "Client -> Load Balancer -> Worker Pool (Least-Conn Routing)" 客户端 → 负载均衡器 → 工作节点池（最小连接数路由） Preserves architectural concepts and flow directions
Physical Street Sign "Pedestrian Crossing Ahead · Speed Limit 30 mph" 前方行人过街通道 · 限速 30 英里/小时 Robust against scene distortions and standard unit conversion

All three sizes (2B / 9B / 35B) provide companion GGUF mmproj vision weights. Try it directly by uploading or pasting images on the Online Demo. See the Image Translation Guide for full details.

2. Audio Multimodal: Index-Echo Speech Dubbing & Multilingual Subtitles

The S2ST panels compare the deployed 2B system, a pipeline, and SeamlessM4T-v2. This demo comparison is separate from the six-direction matched study in the report; SeamlessM4T-v2 does not clone the source voice.

Speech Dubbing (S2ST)Multilingual Subtitles (S2TT)
English video with Japanese dubbing (voice cloned)Same video with subtitles in multiple languages

Click either preview to watch the video, or try Index-Echo online. The website demonstration and the packaged inference interfaces have different language coverage; the model table lists the released interfaces.

Text & Instruction Following Showcase
3. Translate text while preserving a hashtag (JSON Hard Constraint)

Task: translate this JSON into Korean, preserving its structure, stars, and the Chinese hashtag.

{"title": "⭐2月13日例行维护公告⭐", "content": "#热血航线大和登场#"}

Index-Translate-9B:

{"title": "⭐2월 13일 정기 점검 공지⭐", "content": "#热血航线大和登场#"}

The title is translated while the requested hashtag remains unchanged. Try text translation.

4. Keep the meaning of a community expression (MEME & Cultural Slang)

Source: 狒瘾犯了就去打 — in this gaming context, “狒瘾” refers to the urge to play Final Fantasy XIV.

Model English output
Index-Translate-9B When the FFXIV itch hits, just go play.
Index-Translate-2B Go play when my FFXIV addiction kicks in.
Hy-MT2-7B If you get monkey addiction, go fight.
Specialized Domain Showcase (Controlled Dubbing & Long Document)
5. Set the translation's syllable budget (Index-Homura)

Source: 生活两天，是一种什么体验. Index-Homura-9B produces different wording for three requested lengths:

Target / observed syllables English output
10 / 10 to live for two days. What would that be like?
14 / 14 What would it be like to live there for two days, I wonder?
18 / 18 What would it be like to live there for two days, trying to get by somehow?

These three examples meet their targets; syllable control is approximate in general, and spoken duration also depends on delivery. Try Index-Homura.

6. Keep a character's name consistent across a document (Index-NativeLong)

In a roughly 32K-token fantasy document, “王妃” is a character's name. The following extracts compare native full-document translation with the same 9B model in a chunked workflow using neighboring context and an automatic glossary.

Source position Index-NativeLong-9B full document Same 9B with chunking
31.3% Mentor Wang Fei Instructor Wangfei
56.6% Wang Fei the Dean
84.8% Wang Fei The Queen Consort

Positions are measured by source characters. The full-document output keeps the name at these locations; the demo also shows how an externally supplied glossary can repair the chunked result. Try Index-NativeLong.
